name: Wake-on-LAN
author: Harmony-NG Community
description: Turn on PCs, NAS, TVs and consoles with Wake-on-LAN. Add a Wake-on-LAN device, or give any device a command with keyCode PLUGIN:wol:<MAC>.

pairing.title: Find the MAC address
pairing.description: The Hub looks up the MAC address of the device at this IP address.
pairing.instructions: Turn the device on (it must answer on the network), then press Find MAC.

config_fields.label: Hostname / IP Address (optional, for Find MAC)
